Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Pippa Fuseburst. Character visual motifs: short, scarred **adult** stage rigger in fireproof powder-blue jumpsuit, lighting tools, collapsible firing racks and confetti wheels; no Jinx-like weapon swap, zap slow or global rocket execute.
TOP LEFT: Cue Card. Ability concept: Pippa stores one Showstopper token when a **scheduled** explosion catches at least one enemy champion; max 2; one token per cast, no kill-triggered speed frenzy.
TOP RIGHT: Rack and Spark. Ability concept: installs a waist-high fireworks rack for 4 s (2 HP); its indicator previews a thin 45-GU blast lane. After 0.9 s it fires once along that lane, then burns out.
BOTTOM LEFT: Move the Spotlight. Ability concept: rotates an **unfired** rack 90Â° after a 0.45 s warning or, with no rack, drops a small no-damage distraction flare that reveals an area for 2 s.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Opening Night. Ability concept: lays a 120-GU-wide stage grid with **four sequential firing squares**, each warned 0.75 s before ignition. The final square is chosen from three legal candidates at cast start; consumes Showstopper for an additional shield-break pulse (not more raw burst). At every tick at least one contiguous walkable escape cell must remain.
